notes: 25 real merchandise items scanned (receipt itself confirms '# ITEMS SOLD 25') plus one coupon/discount line ('COUPON 23100', -1.00) recorded as a 26th items[] entry with a NEGATIVE lineTotal so items+tax reconciles exactly to the printed total (verified: sum of all 26 lines = 93.62 = printed SUBTOTAL; +4.59 tax = 98.21 = printed TOTAL). Production's Gemini extraction schema (lib/gemini/schema.ts) only accepts NON-NEGATIVE item amounts — this receipt is a deliberate stress case for whether/how the AI handles a coupon line (it may omit it, flip its sign, or fail schema validation entirely if it literally emits a negative number). That is a real finding to report, not a dataset defect. Item names are recorded exactly as printed abbreviated SKU descriptions, not expanded/guessed. Two 'PED PCH 1' and four 'STKO SUNFLWR' lines are literally repeated identical scans (same product bought multiple times) — recorded as separate line items since the receipt itself doesn't aggregate them. Card number is masked to last 4 digits as printed (standard masking, not sensitive). This is ocr.space's own long-standing public demo receipt image; the store manager's name is printed on it (business-role disclosure, not customer PII) — redaction was attempted but no image-editing tool was available in this environment, so it was consciously retained as-is; see eval/dataset/sources.json.
